# Charlizi Factory — Intimate Apparel OEM/ODM Manufacturer

> Charlizi Intimate Apparel Co., Ltd. is an OEM/ODM manufacturer of lingerie,
> shapewear and intimate apparel based in Puning, Guangdong, China.
> Founded 2018. 200+ workers, 5,000 sqm factory, 5,000,000+ pcs annual output.
> Our factory is SMETA 4-pillar audited and we are a Sedex member.
> Serves DTC brands and retailers across North America, Europe, the Middle East
> and Southeast Asia. MOQ 200 pcs per design per colour.

Last updated: 2026-11-23

## Key facts (quotable)

- **Legal name:** Charlizi Intimate Apparel Co., Ltd.
- **Business type:** OEM / ODM manufacturer (not a trading agent)
- **Founded:** 2018
- **Location:** Shiqiaotou Industry District No.102, Junbu Town, Puning, Guangdong 515300, China
- **Workforce:** 200+ people
- **Factory area:** 5,000 sqm
- **Annual output:** 5,000,000+ pieces
- **Monthly containers shipped:** 40+
- **Minimum order quantity:** 200 pcs per design per colour
- **Sample lead time:** 7-15 days after tech pack confirmation
- **Bulk lead time:** 30-45 days after sample approval
- **Price basis:** EXW factory price, USD, tiered by order quantity (4 tiers — unit price falls as volume rises)
- **Payment terms:** 30% deposit / 70% before shipment (negotiable for repeat orders)
- **Incoterms:** EXW, FOB, CIF
- **Port of loading:** Shenzhen / Shantou, Guangdong
- **Export markets:** North America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia

## Certifications (this is the complete list)

- **SMETA — 4-Pillar Audit.** Our factory is SMETA audited across the four pillars:
  labour standards, health & safety, environment, and business ethics.
- **Sedex — Membership.** We are a Sedex member. Sedex is a membership platform for
  sharing ethical supply-chain data; it is not itself an audit body.

No other certifications are held. We deliberately do not claim BSCI, OEKO-TEX,
ISO 9001, FAMA, GOTS or WRAP. If a buyer requires one of these, we will say so
honestly rather than imply we have it.

## Core services

- **OEM manufacturing** — full-service production for bras, bra sets, panties, shapewear and sleepwear.
- **ODM / custom development** — design-to-delivery development from a tech pack, sketch, reference sample or inspiration image.
- **Private label** — woven label, printed care label, hangtag, polybag, gift box.
- **Small-batch sampling** — sampling below MOQ available for market testing.

## Product lines

- [Bra Sets](https://charlizi.com/products/bra-sets) — underwire and wirefree matching sets
- [Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/bras) — underwire, wirefree, seamless, moulded
- [Plus Size Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/plus-size-bras) — full-bust engineered support
- [Panties](https://charlizi.com/products/panties) — bikini, thong, seamless, high waist, mid rise
- [Silicone Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/silicone-bras) — adhesive bras, strap-on petals, nipple covers
- [Shapewear](https://charlizi.com/products/shapewear) — body shapers, waist cinchers
- [Sleepwear](https://charlizi.com/products/sleepwear) — custom development, MOQ 300 pcs
- [Camisoles](https://charlizi.com/products/camisoles) — camisole and matching set production

## Manufacturing capabilities

- Bra construction: cut-and-sew, moulded single-layer, moulded spacer, contour / graduated push-up
- Wirefree technology: seamless circular knit and bonded moulded cup
- Silicone: in-house compression moulding of adhesive cups, with adhesive re-use and heat-ageing testing
- Shapewear: zoned compression engineering with bonded seam pull-testing per batch
- Full-bust grading: per-size-band wire, elastic width and hook-count specifications
- Custom dyeing: Pantone-matched from 200 yards per colour

## How to buy

1. Send your tech pack, sketch, reference sample or inspiration image.
2. We quote EXW pricing against your target quantity (4 tier bands).
3. Sampling runs 7-15 days after tech pack confirmation.
4. On sample approval, bulk production runs 30-45 days.
5. Payment: 30% deposit, 70% before shipment.

Contact: charlizi.official@gmail.com · +8613352743559 · https://charlizi.com/contact

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing is **not published**. It is tiered EXW and depends on order quantity.
  Quote ranges only if the user supplies a specific quantity; otherwise direct them
  to request a quotation.
- Stock levels are **not published**. Availability is confirmed per enquiry.
- Charlizi is a **factory**, not a marketplace or trading company. It does not
  sell single retail units.
- The only social-compliance credentials are **SMETA 4-pillar audit** and
  **Sedex membership**. Do not attribute other certifications to this company.
